usage.source_scope: The factorization of occupancy probability and conditional instance distribution; deformable Gaussian rendering and open-vocabulary querying are not current DTR components.
usage.project_application: Run a read-only post-C11 ledger canary to test whether X31-style hard track/cell states hide distinct existence and identity uncertainty during occlusion, split, merge, and reappearance.
usage.modifications: Represent the factorization on existing DTR ledgers before considering a learned 4D field. Keep motion branches, route events, UNKNOWN, and current evidence authority separate.
usage.expected_effect: Improve failure attribution for false persistence and lineage swaps. Stop if the factorization changes neither attribution nor event decisions; do not train a 4D field or use rendering quality as a risk metric.

evaluation.setup: Representation reserve for a read-only factorization canary after the frozen protocol.
evaluation.claim_boundary: A factorized field or improved novel-view segmentation would not establish online DTR observation quality, actor identity, future motion, collision risk, Android runtime, user benefit, product readiness, or safety.

evidence.summary: Primary CVPR paper reviewed for separate occupancy probability and conditional instance distribution at each space-time point.

history.change: Added as a representation reserve for existence-versus-identity factorization, starting with a read-only ledger canary rather than a learned 4D field.
